newsitem.title: UK: Academic says EU ag reform must stress development.
newsitem.headline: Academic says EU ag reform must stress development.

text.p: Future reform of EU farm policy must emphasise rural development and the environment, a leading UK farm sector academic said today.
Allan Buckwell is professor of agricultural economics at the University of London's Wye College and an advisor to UK farm ministers.

He said that reform "must take place in order to reflect the requirements of an enlarged EU as well as address a number of internal dissatisfactions over the complexity and restrictive nature of the present scheme."
Buckwell was giving the Asher Weingarten Memorial Lecture at the England and Wales National Farmers Union.

He called for future reform of the EU Common Agricultural Policy to "adopt a more integrated approach towards a common agricultural and rural policy which emphasises rural development in all EU countries."
